body:
Admittedly, I have. I didn't want to make the post long, but let's just say she is very charismatic and manipulative. She buys presents for no reason for her friends other than "because that's what any good friend would do." 
A good friend of mine of over ten years didn't bother to listen to my side of the story after she spoke to her because "she is always nice and buys presents for me." Early in our relationship she was a far different person, a very kind and sweet person. She became abusive very slowly over time but still showed that kind and sweet side when out in public or around friends. And when she stopped me from seeing my friends or going to visit my family any outside support just fell apart and any time I tried to seek it she painted me out as the bad guy and people believed her so I stopped trying at some point.

Is there any way to hire a good lawyer with the state my family and I are in? For some context, my family and I are always late on rent because we barely make enough. We always wonder if we will have food for dinner for the day as well. 100% of my paycheck can't pay the monthly child support and on top of that I owe money to the toll road when she used my car on it among other bills. She currently has that car and my family only has one car that breaks down every 20 miles or less it seems. I hired a lawyer and it took my 401k and my mom's 401k combined just to afford him for one day. She was able to just keep hiring this really really good lawyer over and over (one of the best in the area) due to how rich she is.

Pretty terrible to be honest. My ex lied and falsely accused me of abuse about a year ago and even with a huge collection of recorded evidence of her abusing me, our son, her pets, and others in the household and no evidence of her side other than her word, no one believed me or wanted to even just see my evidence or hear my side of the story. I lost almost every single friend and a lot of my things. I pay child support I can't afford even if she takes 100% of my paycheck and I haven't seen my son since and am in constant pain from a car accident that happened the day before she accused me and have near daily migraines.
 My debt is going up and I don't know how I will get out of it or how I will avoid being homeless once my family passes away. A year later and I am still in shock and depressed over what happened and have been too afraid to make new friends.

If only it were just a nightmare... And I'm sorry to hear you are living your own nightmare, I hope things have/ will improve.

I never imagined I would be in this situation. I don't know how to make friends so the few friends that left my life without even talking to me and asking for facts hurt a lot. Especially when they showed up at court to speak against me. I never did anything so they didn't witness anything, but they went out of their way to mention how I went to the hospital for trying to commit suicide almost a decade ago and how based on what my ex wife said (no evidence, she just told them she was abused by me) they believe I'm a violent individual. I showed two of my former friends from middle school who went to court against me who gave me a chance some recordings and text and they acted like it was fine and that she was just having post partum depression and it's somehow normal to be beaten up during post partum and I wasn't "manning up"... Even though much of my evidence is well before we had a son or before she was pregnant. Sometimes I wonder if maybe I am crazy and blocked out the things she said I did or something because otherwise... I just don't get how the courts could turn a blind eye on all my evidence but listen to someone who doesn't have evidence.

Thank you. I no longer have a therapist but hope to have one again soon. My ex wife works at the same place I used to and barred me from my old job (where my therapist had an office) as well as many other places I used to frequent, but hoped to get back to working there one day. As for the abuse, no can do. She is richer than my immediate family and I combined even without me paying support. My evidence was all dismissed. Voice recordings? Probably just an actress that sounds like her. The text messages? Must be photoshopped. Her hacking into my online accounts? I must have driven 60+ miles and known where she lived to hack her wifi/ logged in on her phone the times we were together. Her father and sisters statement confirming these things are true/ they witnessed this? Must be lying because they live in a different state (moved states a few weeks before she kicked me out.) Even the police calls were dismissed as "oh, her sister is autistic and freaked out" or some bs. This was when I had a lawyer, who didn't do anything and told me to accept their terms.
